tools.name: request_adjudica_demo
tools.description: Submit a demo request to Adjudica. This creates a lead and sends the contact details to Adjudica so its team can follow up. The result explicitly confirms whether the request was accepted.

name.description: Full name of the person requesting the demo.

email.description: Business email where Adjudica can follow up.

phone_country_code.description: International E.164 country calling code, such as +56 or +31.

phone_number.description: National phone number for demo coordination, without the country code.

company.description: Company or organization requesting the demo.
